prompt: Create an original 180 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 126 BPM; G minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic electronic track featuring a prominent synth melody, driving synth bass, and dynamic electronic drums. It has a retro-futuristic vibe with evolving synth layers and a strong rhythmic pulse.
description.zh: 一首欢快且充满活力的电子音乐，以突出的合成器旋律、强劲的合成器贝斯和动感的电子鼓为特色。它具有复古未来主义的氛围，合成器层层递进，节奏感强烈。
